head_note: The head of Copilot's first review of the PR.
title: Let the Client cancel a job request the runner has not started
notes_basis: The PR description as it is today. It has no Copilot section.
notes:
Same change as https://github.com/adam-drag/ai-orchestrator/pull/13.

A job request that waits for the runner could not be cancelled or dismissed. A request with a wrong repository path would therefore start Staff as soon as the runner came up.

- `POST /api/job-requests/:id/cancel` (`cancelJobRequest` in `src/job-requests.ts`) closes the request and its launch in one transaction. It is refused once the runner has taken the launch, and for a request that already became a job. The route needs the Client session like every other dashboard route, and `test/client-auth.test.ts` now lists it among the routes that answer 401 without one.
- The dashboard has **Cancel** on the New job form while it waits for the runner, and in Recent requests. The Jobs page lists a waiting request as a queued row with **Cancel**.
- The activity feed shows the cancellation. The user guide explains it.

Checks: `pnpm typecheck` is clean. `pnpm test`: 158 passed. The full e2e suite on a fresh stack: 23 passed, 1 skipped (the live map screenshot), including the new cancel test.

copilot_findings.label: Cancel is offered for a queued request whose launch the runner already picked up; the server refuses it
A failed fetch of the request list is not shown, so the page reads as empty
Cancelling in another tab leaves the start page spinning, it has no cancelled state
